sourcePolicy: This fertilizer schedule is educational and limited to locally validated extension guidance. Always follow the current label and local agronomy advisory before applying any nutrient source.

entries.productName: Tomato nutrient schedule (NPK as per local recommendation)
entries.composition: Urea + SSP or DAP + MOP, adjusted to soil test results
entries.purpose: Supports root establishment, flowering, and fruit set in tomato.
entries.application: Apply basal dose before planting and top-dress in split applications during vegetative and fruiting stages.
entries.safety: Do not exceed label rates and avoid applying on waterlogged soil.
entries.source: State agriculture university and ICAR nutrient recommendations

entries.productName: Wheat nutrient schedule (NPK as per local recommendation)
entries.composition: Urea, DAP, MOP tuned for soil test values
entries.purpose: Improves tillering, grain filling, and yield in wheat.
entries.application: Apply basal at sowing and split nitrogen top-dress at tillering and booting stages.
entries.safety: Follow local soil test recommendations and avoid heavy irrigation immediately after application.

entries.productName: Rice nutrient schedule (NPK as per local recommendation)
entries.composition: Urea with basal phosphate and potash, plus split N top dressing
entries.purpose: Supports early growth, panicle development, and healthy grain filling.
entries.application: Apply basal before transplanting and split N at transplanting, tillering, and panicle initiation.
entries.safety: Avoid over-application in flooded fields without soil test advice.
